---
title: "Declare the Native Runtime"
subtitle: "Review the project’s Spack requirements before building anything"
execute:
  eval: false
---

This page adds the project components to the empty workshop. `spack.yaml` is
the reviewable declaration; it is deliberately not concretized or installed
here. The next page turns this declaration into a Singularity recipe and builds
the runtime inside the pinned Rocky 9 workshop.

The runtime uses the `x86_64_v3` CPU baseline rather than the Sapphire Rapids
build host. This preserves the broadly useful AVX2/FMA baseline while
excluding AVX-512/VNNI, and applies the policy to every dependency rather than
as a package-specific compiler-flag workaround.

`targets` loads `igraph`, whose artifact requires `libglpk.so.40` and
`libflexiblas.so.3`. `glpk` and `flexiblas` are therefore direct Spack
specifications: OpenBLAS does not satisfy FlexiBLAS's distinct SONAME. R
packages remain project-local and are declared after the runtime exists with
`uvr`.

::: {.manual-procedure .emit-config-yaml file="{{ emit.project_root }}/spack.yaml" title="Emit the project runtime declaration"}

```yaml
spack:
  specs:
  - r@4.5.1
  - libxml2
  - icu4c
  - libx11
  - git
  - curl
  - openssl
  - libgit2
  - cmake
  - gmake
  - freetype
  - libjpeg-turbo
  - libpng
  - libtiff
  - libwebp
  - fontconfig
  - fribidi
  - harfbuzz
  - libuv
  - glpk
  - flexiblas
  view: true
  concretizer:
    unify: true
  packages:
    all:
      require:
      - target=x86_64_v3
  config:
    template_dirs:
    - $env/containers/templates
    - $spack/share/spack/templates
  container:
    format: singularity
    images:
      os: rockylinux:9
      spack: 1.2.0
    template: KiribatiBioMarkers.def.j2
    os_packages:
      final:
      - ca-certificates
      - findutils
      - gzip
      - tar
      - which
      - gcc
      - gcc-c++
      - make
```

:::

::: {.manual-check title="Verify the declaration before building"}

```sh
quarto render notebooks --profile emit --no-execute
rg -n 'r@4.5.1|glpk|flexiblas|target=x86_64_v3|rockylinux:9' spack.yaml
```

:::
